integrity: The accompanying proof is analytical; exact-rational finite checker assertions are corroborating, not a proof of all real parameter cases.
scientific_limitations: Exact for a four-vertex fixed-demand affine nonatomic routing game with only the added arc tolled; not a general network theorem, not elastic demand, and no empirical causal interpretation. Earlier equivalent formulas in transport-economics literature remain possible.
title: Revenue-optimal shortcut tolls preserve the complete Braess harm interval
